name: Microsoft MCP Gateway
summary: Reverse proxy and management layer for MCP servers on Kubernetes, with stateless request routing, authorization, lifecycle management and a tool gateway router.
description: Breaking change in the current version: it requires MCP `2026-07-28` clients and adapters, with no legacy initialization, transport sessions or protocol downgrade (see docs/mcp-2026-07-28.md). Tools are registered resources routed by a Tool Gateway Router MCP server.
